catalog.container_strategy: Build CPU components in dev; export matching runtime and utility bundle to target. Region instrumentation is an explicitly separate diagnostic treatment.
catalog.purpose: Provide program-region instrumentation, CPU counters, uncore and RAPL components for explanatory performance analysis.
qualification_gaps: A physical target CPU, kernel, PMU and container launch profile must pass feature-specific collection probes; an installed executable is not full runtime qualification.
PAPI presets are not universally implemented; validate the requested native events and multiplex ratio.
catalog.size_basis: complete HTTP GET, byte count and SHA-256 computed locally
catalog.title: PAPI hardware counter API

recipe.component_selection_note: PAPI 7.2.0 enables perf_event and perf_event_uncore by default and appends --with-components. Add rapl once; preserve the default sysdetect component. Listing perf_event_uncore again creates duplicate linker symbols.

activation: Use the resolved absolute command paths shown here. No system-wide PATH or alternatives changes are made.

examples.description: Read component availability and disabled reasons

locations.label: Native event query
locations.purpose: List native events supported by the current component view

locations.label: Installed API examples and checks
locations.purpose: Read-only API client source and the resource check entry point; runtime reports keep hardware limitations explicit.

notes: The deployment check validates component enumeration and preserves disabled reasons; it does not claim a requested event can be measured.
The source-built 7.2.0 prefix and APT papi-tools 7.1.0 are separate versions; select an explicit command/library pair.
The complete binary profile uses its declared fixed prefix. Build for the final container path; another path is rejected. Original full source and original profile remain in the workspace baseline.

GNU Fortran is a build-only dependency for the original Fortran support. The runtime C library and bundled libpfm remain in this prefix; a Fortran consumer additionally needs its normal compiler/runtime environment.
usage.summary: Inspect PAPI components and use the C API for explicitly instrumented counter collection.
